svg.title: MEMO architecture and assurance V-model
svg.desc: Architecture perspectives form horizontal rows. Requirements, safety and risk, cybersecurity, human factors, and verification and validation form assurance columns. Architecture is decomposed down the left side of a V and integrated and evaluated up the right side.

g.text: THE MEMO ARCHITECTURE AND ASSURANCE V-MODEL
Architecture moves from operational intent to realization. Assurance disciplines own and evaluate elements at every architecture level.
decompose intent into a realizable design
Typed relationships connect architecture, assurance claims, V&V results, and evidence across every layer.
The model records what each discipline owns and how each claim is evaluated without duplicating the underlying element.
